item.title: Shootin' the Breeze | Ep. 105 - Severe storms, winter storms, & drought
item.description: Central Illinois experienced a record-breaking storm with an EF3 tornado in Kankakee, record-breaking hail, and a line of storms south of I-80, while the full episode of Shootin' the Breeze can be streamed for free on WMBD+.

item.title: IDOT urges drivers to plan ahead for sober ride ahead of St. Patrick’s Day celebrations
item.description: The Illinois Department of Transportation is reminding drivers to plan ahead and celebrate responsibly this St. Patrick's Day weekend, as increased celebrations often lead to more impaired drivers on the road, and extra law enforcement will be out across the state from March 13 through March 23.

item.title: Washington discusses potential kratom ban
item.description: The Washington city council discussed a potential ban on kratom at a Monday meeting, citing alleged overdose deaths, but ultimately decided to wait for state regulation before taking any action.

item.title: Normal finds new bidder for Uptown underpass project
item.description: The Town of Normal is working with a new bidder for the Uptown Normal underpass project, hoping to secure a deal by the end of the month and bring more economic and housing opportunities to the area.

item.title: YouthBuild McLean County honors WMBD anchor with award
item.description: WMBD news anchor Breanna Rittman was honored with the Community Champion Award by YouthBuild of McLean County for her support and positivity towards the organization.

item.title: Peoria Heights voters to weigh in on grocery tax question in March 17 election
item.description: Peoria Heights voters will soon vote on whether to reestablish a 1% local grocery tax, which could generate up to $135,000 in revenue for the village, but Mayor Matt Wigginton believes it would place an additional burden on families already dealing with high food costs.

item.title: Body found in damaged home after Kankakee storms
item.description: The Kankakee Sheriff's Office located a person believed to have died in Tuesday's storms at Aroma Park on Thursday, and the coroner confirmed the death inside a damaged residence.

item.title: Illinois Republican lawmakers file bills to keep human traffickers in prison
item.description: Three Republican state lawmakers have filed three bills to crack down on human traffickers, including increasing penalties, eliminating plea deals, and requiring sex offenders to register for unauthorized recording of minors.

item.title: Big fourth quarter sends Manual to state championship game
item.description: CHAMPAIGN, Ill. (WMBD/WYZZ) -- Manual saved its best for last. The Rams outscored Tolono Unity 22-13 in the fourth quarter and charged into the state title game with a 62-57 win over the Rockets in the class 2A state semifinals at State Farm Center on Thursday. item.title: UPDATE: One dead after crash on Allen Road in Peoria
item.description: One person was killed and two others were critically injured in a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of North Allen Road and West Altorfer Drive in Peoria, Illinois on Thursday, and the infant inside the vehicle was taken to the hospital with minor injuries.
